list_private_slack_channels.description: A Slack assistant that uses Claude through LangSmith Gateway with tools for visible, public, private, eval-, and customer- channels.

list_channels.description: List every active public and accessible private Slack channel visible to the configured identity.

list_public.description: List every active public Slack channel visible to the configured identity.

list_private.description: List every active private Slack channel accessible to the configured identity.

list_eval_channels.description: List every visible public and private Slack channel whose name starts with eval-.

list_customer_channels.description: List every visible public and private Slack channel whose name starts with customer-.

refresh_channels.description: Refresh the durable Slack channel snapshot for the authenticated caller.

match_accounts_to_channels.description: Match Salesforce account names to cached Slack channels with membership status.
